messages:
alex: quick heads-up — SDK PR #4827 is blocked on an API change in the api repo (PR #2719). console e2e fails if header rename goes through. linking details below.

alex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4827
alex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/2719

maria: link + error pls? want to triage quickly.

alex: console-e2e output:```
FAILED header-transform.test.ts
expect(received).toEqual(expected) // deep equality
- Expected: "X-Request-Id"
+ Received: "X-Rex"
```

ci-bot: console-e2e pipeline failed on staging branch — failing test: header-transform.test.ts

kevin: which header rename is this? api PR description says "x-rex -> x-request-id" for standardization.

sam: SDK just forwards headers; if API removes old header app-level consumers (console) break. we need a compatibility plan.

julia: console team: our mocks assert X-Rex; changing to X-Request-Id broke a couple integration fixtures. we can change console, but need a green runtime in staging to validate.

alex: proposal: accept api change but add a lightweight shim in runtime (helm) that maps X-Rex -> X-Request-Id for one release. sam can open helm PR. merge order idea: helm canary -> run console e2e -> merge api -> merge SDK -> remove shim next release.

maria: sounds reasonable. who owns helm PR? need a config snippet for nginx/ingress to preserve header.

sam: I got this. I'll open helm PR #319 and add a ConfigMap patch:```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  proxy-headers.conf: |
    map $http_x_rex $http_x_request_id {
      "" $http_x_request_id;
      default $http_x_rex;
    }
```

kevin: nice. after helm canary is up, console smoke e2e should be run against canary endpoint. if green, we can proceed with api merge.

alex: @julia can you run the smoke suite once ops-bot reports the canary deployment?

julia: yup — once ops-bot says deployed I'll run smoke (quick subset) + full e2e in staging. ETA ~2h after deploy.

ops-bot: helm PR #319 merged and deployed to staging-canary (runtime image: runtime:2.14.1-canary).

ci-bot: console-e2e: running smoke suite against staging-canary...

julia: smoke suite green. one flake in auth-rotate (flake ticket opened) but header tests pass. full e2e queued.

maria: great — I'm okay approving SDK after api merge. I can add approval once api PR is merged and SDK CI is green.

kevin: reminder to bump SDK compatibility matrix and changelog after merge. small PR fine.

alex: can someone watch the merge window? prefer to merge within next 30m during light merges. I'll monitor and roll back if needed.

maria: I can take the merge. will merge api PR, then ping here, then watch SDK CI.

sam: helm shim will be removed in next minor once SDK/console have switched. I'll add TODO note in the helm PR.

alex: thanks all — ping me if anything flaps. :thumbsup:

julia: follow-up: full console e2e passed after canary. approving for production smoke tomorrow morning per runbook.

maria: merged api PR #2719 at 1765001502, tagging release v1.22.0. unblocking SDK PR.

maria: approved SDK PR #4827 and queued merge, waiting on green CI.

alex: merging window now. I'll post a short rollback playbook if we see errors.

ci-bot: sdk-ci pipeline passed. ready to merge.

maria: merged SDK PR #4827 at 1765001589. :party_popper:
